get.description: Retrieves details of a single message in the specified IM session.

post.description: Initiates a session with a template message. This API is used only for WhatsApp Integration.
post.x-system-description: If the canned message contains placeholders, resolve them before calling this API. Use the Apply Canned Message API to replace placeholders with the correct values; a contactId and either a ticketId or sessionId is required for that step. If the user does not provide a sessionId, ask the user for the replacement values needed for the placeholders before proceeding.

post.description: Starts a Facebook Messenger session outside the standard messaging window using the Facebook comment ID and Facebook user ID from a post where the user interacted. Prerequisites: In facebookMessengerPayload, facebookUserId and facebookCommentId must be provided. If they are not passed in the payload, the API throws an error. Note: A single message can be sent with a given comment ID. Send the request as application/json for text-only sessions, or as multipart/form-data with a file attachment and the session JSON in the payload query parameter.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Session payload for Facebook Messenger as a JSON string. Required when using multipart/form-data with a file attachment. Use the same structure as the application/json request body. Omit message in facebookMessengerPayload when a file is attached because Facebook does not allow both attachment and message together.

schema.description: JSON string matching the application/json request body schema (integrationServiceId, facebookMessengerPayload, meta).
